train_seconds_note: mean wall-clock seconds to train one seed (incl. per-epoch val); per seed below
input: 12 channels: S2 B2 B3 B4 B5 B8 B8A B11 B12 reflectance and S1 VV VH dB, each z-scored with train-split mean/std (stats.json); NaN -> 0 after z-scoring; plus optical validity mask (all 8 bands finite) and SAR validity mask (VV and VH finite)
architecture: U-Net, 4 down levels, widths 32-64-128-256-512, 2x(conv3x3-BN-ReLU) per block, maxpool down, ConvTranspose2d up, 1x1 head to 2 classes

config.augmentation: one of identity/hflip/vflip/rot180 per batch, uniform
